execution_frontier.name: Cross-replicate inference-only isolation of R2B batch-384 regression
execution_frontier.summary: Two independent protected-R2B runs both remained fully robust through global batch 256 with model_g.flow and model_g.dp frozen/hash-stable, then first showed a strengthened-machine regression at global batch 384. Replicate 1 failed the primary gate 123/125; replicate 2 still passed the primary gate 125/125 but failed the five-seed gate 125/125/124/125/124. The exact failing rows differ across runs, so the batch-257..384 loss of robustness is stochastic/nondeterministic rather than a single-checkpoint accident. Before defining R2C, run the rollback matrix against both independent batch-384 checkpoints and each run's own proven batch-256 reference.

promoted_r1_hybrid.strengthened_gate: 125/125 on each of five deterministic schedules; 625/625 total

protected_r2_abort64.diagnosis: model_g.dp drift was the minimum sufficient cause of the batch-64 robustness regression
protected_r2_abort64.repair: restore model_g.dp from promoted R1 hybrid and freeze/hash-protect both model_g.dp and model_g.flow

cross_replicate_interpretation.note: Replicate disagreement at batch 384 demonstrates nondeterministic training/inference sensitivity; choose the next protection rule only if it restores 625/625 across both independent run states.

next_safe_execution.acceptance_rule: A rollback/protection candidate is eligible for R2C design only if it restores 125/125 on all five seeds in both independent replicates.

unfreeze or update model_g.flow or model_g.dp
discard the last proven batch-256 checkpoints without evidence
weaken the -55 dBFS waveform floor, 0.08 s duration floor, or multi-seed gate
select a lucky run, seed, or noise setting as promotion evidence
enter human perceptual acceptance before protected R2 machine success
treat machine waveform acceptance as human CNS perceptual acceptance
